erratum: r7.81a stopped before scoring because some event-window seconds contain no marker detection at all. r7.81b never fabricates an obstacle: it scores only marker-present event frames, retains the r7.67a nearest-patch fallback for real sub-patch detections, reports excluded frame count, and fails if any frozen event loses all rows. Labels, source splits, alpha, threshold, weighting, and gates remain unchanged.

data.rows: marker-present subset of exact r7.64 eval event frames
data.eligibility: cached expanded marker mask is non-empty or hash-bound raw detections produce the frozen r7.67a nearest-patch fallback
data.marker_absent_frames: excluded and counted; never assigned a fabricated mask
data.event_retention: every frozen event must retain at least one eligible row
data.labels: frozen provisional VLM event role; route intrusion=1, safe-lateral/context negative=0
data.parent_source_isolation: leave one complete source ID out

feature_vector.input: frozen r7.64 43x16x16 causal tensor and actual marker mask
feature_vector.empty_mask_fallback: per-detection nearest 16x16 patch from r7.67a hash-bound raw detections

probe.target: binary event role copied only to eligible frames inside the parent-isolated event
probe.standardization: training-fold weighted mean and standard deviation only
probe.weighting: equal class mass, equal source mass within class, equal frame mass within source; total weight equals training row count
